description_full:
🚀 OPEN RECRUITMENT – PAID INTERNSHIP (GROWTERNSHIP BATCH )

What is Growternship?
Growternship adalah program magang 2 bulan berbasis real working experience (WFH) yang dirancang untuk bantu kamu develop skill, build portfolio, dan accelerate career growth secara terarah.

💰 BENEFITS (YES, PAID 💸)
1. Uang saku / pocket money setiap bulan
2. Bonus performance untuk top interns
3. Kesempatan jadi paid part-time / permanent role
4. Peluang naik ke manager / head level
5. Akses ke profit-sharing program (passive income opportunity)
6. Bisa Konversi SKS

🎯 AVAILABLE ROLES
1. Hands-on project execution (real project, not simulation)
2. Cross-team collaboration (explore multiple roles)
3. Industry-relevant skill development
4. Strategic exposure ke real working environment
5. Structured growth pathway (clear & measurable progress)

🗓 TIMELINE
- Duration: 2 Months Program
- System: WFH (Remote – fleksibel dari mana saja)
- Schedule: Structured & guided (bukan random learning)

🗓 SELECTION TIMELINE

Registration Period
12 –18 November 2026

CV Screening
19–21 November 2026

Announcement Stage 1
22 November 2026

Interview Process
23 November - 1 Desember 2026

Final Announcement
3 Desember 2026

🔥 Don't just look for experience — build real growth with YouthGrwoth Ventures
